Use case: ui-mockup. Produce ONE polished 16:9 full-screen visual proposal for TalesTactics, a Korean fantasy tactical RPG. This is a proposed future game screenshot, not a poster or moodboard. Reference image 2 is the CURRENT game: retain its fantasy heroes, readable small chibi sprite style, isometric tactical perspective and ruined stone/water environment, while elevating terrain quality greatly. No robots, no sci-fi machines, no copied logos.
Scene: a beautiful playable ancient forest ruin courtyard integrated into surrounding landscape, organically connected paths instead of an isolated rectangular board pasted on a painting. Warm sun through varied oak and conifer canopies, dense forest at outer edges only, layered moss-covered stone ledges, cracked stone paving interrupted by grass patches, ferns, roots, scattered rubble, short broken pillars, shallow turquoise stream and a stone bridge; carefully shaded terrain, contact shadows and subtle atmospheric depth. Keep central movement routes open and readable. Use premium 2.5D painterly strategy game terrain with convincing material texture and elevation, matched lighting across background and board. Six small fantasy allies and four dark armored enemies, grounded shadows, thin cyan/red health bars, selected blond red-headband swordsman in silver armor/red cape with blue sword. Restrained cyan movement squares only near the selected unit; clear beige selection brackets.
HUD: restrained decorative fantasy-metal UI inspired by user reference, dark ink navy translucent body, substantial beveled brushed-silver double borders (outer rim plus thin inset), antique gold reinforced cut-corner accents, thin teal light line, tasteful small etched details. Right compact command stack with '이동' selected in rich gold, followed by '공격', '기술', '방어', '대기'. World fills about 80% screen. Do not add new mechanics or clutter. Professional detailed high-resolution game UI art direction mockup, no outside presentation margins, no watermark.
